description_en: Updates the resource group, collection scope, scheduling, and extension configurations of a specified metadata crawler
description_zh: 更新指定元数据采集器的资源组、采集范围、调度和扩展配置
name: UpdateCrawler

parameters.help_en: The ID of the metadata crawler. You can call ListCrawlers to query crawler IDs
parameters.help_zh: 元数据采集器 ID。您可以通过 ListCrawlers 查询
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Serverless 2.0 resource group used to run the collection task. Whether this parameter is supported and whether it is required depend on the capabilities returned by GetCrawlerTypeCapabilities. If this parameter is not specified, the existing value remains unchanged
parameters.help_zh: 运行采集任务使用的 Serverless 2.0 资源组 ID。是否支持以及是否需要填写以 GetCrawlerTypeCapabilities 返回的能力为准；未传入时保持不变
parameters.name: resource_group_id

fields.help_en: The regular expression used to exclude objects from the collection scope. This parameter is supported only when SupportExcludeRegex returned by GetCrawlerTypeCapabilities is set to true
fields.help_zh: 采集范围排除正则表达式。仅当 GetCrawlerTypeCapabilities 返回的 SupportExcludeRegex 为 true 时支持
fields.name: exclude_regex

fields.help_en: The list of database names. This parameter is supported only when Unit is set to DATABASE. A maximum of 1,000 entries are allowed. Names cannot be empty or duplicate
fields.help_zh: 数据库名称列表。仅当 Unit 为 DATABASE 时支持填写，最多 1000 个，名称不能为空或重复
fields.name: items

fields.help_en: The collection scope granularity. Valid values are determined by the SupportedScopeUnits returned by GetCrawlerTypeCapabilities
fields.help_zh: 采集范围粒度。可选值以 GetCrawlerTypeCapabilities 返回的 SupportedScopeUnits 为准
fields.name: unit

parameters.help_en: The collection scope configuration. If this parameter is specified, the collection scope is updated. If this parameter is not specified, the existing value remains unchanged
parameters.help_zh: 采集范围配置。传入时更新采集范围；未传入时保持不变
parameters.name: scope

fields.help_en: The six-field cron expression for periodic scheduling. This parameter is required when Type is set to NORMAL. The seconds field must be 0, and the scheduling frequency cannot exceed once per hour
fields.help_zh: 周期调度的六段式 Cron 表达式。Type 为 NORMAL 时必填；秒位必须为 0，调度频率不得高于每小时一次
fields.name: cron_express

fields.help_en: The scheduling type. MANUAL indicates manual execution. NORMAL indicates periodic scheduling. Data sources in the development environment support only MANUAL. Whether NORMAL is available depends on the SupportSchedule value returned by GetCrawlerTypeCapabilities
fields.help_zh: 调度类型。MANUAL 表示手动运行，NORMAL 表示周期调度。开发环境数据源仅支持 MANUAL；NORMAL 是否可用以 GetCrawlerTypeCapabilities 返回的 SupportSchedule 为准
fields.name: type

parameters.help_en: The scheduling configuration. If this parameter is specified, the scheduling method is updated. If this parameter is not specified, the existing value remains unchanged
parameters.help_zh: 调度配置。传入时更新调度方式；未传入时保持不变
parameters.name: schedule_config

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable AI metadata description. This parameter is supported only when SupportAiComment returned by GetCrawlerTypeCapabilities is set to true. If this parameter is not specified, the existing value remains unchanged
parameters.help_zh: 是否启用 AI 元数据描述。仅当 GetCrawlerTypeCapabilities 返回的 SupportAiComment 为 true 时支持；未传入时保持不变
parameters.name: enable_ai_comment

parameters.help_en: The extension configurations for the crawler type. Only the specified configuration items are updated. Unspecified configuration items remain unchanged. The supported keys and values are determined by the SupportedOptionKeys returned by GetCrawlerTypeCapabilities
parameters.help_zh: 采集器类型的扩展配置。仅更新传入的配置项，未传入的配置项保持不变；支持的键和值以 GetCrawlerTypeCapabilities 返回的 SupportedOptionKeys 为准
parameters.name: options

Id.description_en: The ID of the updated metadata crawler
Id.description_zh: 更新后的元数据采集器 ID

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can use this ID to locate logs and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID。用于定位日志，排查问题

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
